entities.summary: James Marshall Hawkins was an American professional basketball player. Hawkins was selected in the 1948 BAA Draft by the Boston Celtics. He played for the Indianapolis Olympians in 1949–50, but prior to that he spent one season playing for the Oshkosh All-Stars in the National Basketball League.
